prompt: Lens low on wet cobbles, wide 24mm, looking up at a craggy Irish American beat cop of about 58 who bends down toward us as though to tell a secret. Long creased clean-shaven face, broken nose, big ears, grey eyebrows, dark 1920s tunic buttoned to a collar sitting below his jaw, tall domed helmet. A streetlamp at his shoulder throws sick yellow-green over his face, and the wet stones bounce it up onto his mouth and chin. At the far end of the empty street, small and off to one side, a motor paddy wagon burns scarlet on the cobbles. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
